name: pollinations-browser-agent
description: AI-driven browser automation workflow: Playwright + Pollinations legacy (Classic) API, with a screenshot captured for every action.

scripts.demo: node src/cli.js --task "Search the catalogue for 'notebook' and report its price" --url file://$PWD/demo/site/index.html --max-steps 6
scripts.agent:puppeteer: node src/cli.js --engine puppeteer --task "Search the catalogue for 'notebook', add it to the cart, and report its price" --url file://$PWD/demo/site/index.html --max-steps 5 --budget-ms 240000
scripts.agent:playwright: node src/cli.js --engine playwright --task "Search the catalogue for 'notebook', add it to the cart, and report its price" --url file://$PWD/demo/site/index.html --max-steps 5 --budget-ms 240000
